programs.title: Kindig Customs
programs.desc: Deep down, KevDogg is a truck guy, so when a truck show comes through town, he takes the reins and shows Dave what is what with all the great builds.

programs.title: Salvage Hunters
programs.desc: Drew Pritchard heads to a manor house in Oxfordshire, where the classic exterior hides a weird and wonderful interior. Then, at a reclamation yard near Newcastle, Drew meets the next generation of antiques dealers.

programs.title: Wheeler Dealers World Tour
programs.desc: In their most ambitious project yet, Mike and Elvis aim to build a tribute to Paddy Hopkirk's winning 1964 Mini Cooper. Will it cross the finish line?

programs.title: Gold Rush
programs.desc: Todd Hoffman's crew has quit, and he desperately tries to keep mining with a skeleton team. Parker Schnabel carelessly breaks his truck's air hoses while transporting his washplant, and Tony Beets discovers his dredge is blowing gold out of the sluices.
